baseline.responsive: Every size, spacing, gap, column count, alignment and visibility option has a value per breakpoint.
baseline.schemes: Light and dark from the theme palette tokens (no hard-coded colours); follows the visitor scheme toggle.
baseline.hover_note: Presets come from settings.custom.hover (zoom, lift, shadow, duration, ease…) so a demo restyles every element at once.
accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in both schemes
seo: semantic HTML tags selectable (h1–h6, p, div, section, article…)
schema where the type has one (FAQPage, Product, Event, Review…)
performance: CSS and JS load only on pages that use the element
builders: same options and output in both
